About

What IndieLab is

IndieLab is a small gift-guide publication. We watch what people actually search for and save on Pinterest and Amazon, then write the guide we would want before buying: who the product suits, what to check, what the honest downsides are, and how to gift it well.

How we pick

Every pick starts as a search trend — real people looking for a real problem to solve. We check the listing, the variants and the details that matter before writing. If a product has a limitation worth knowing, it goes in the guide, not under the rug.

How we earn

Guides contain Amazon affiliate links. If you buy through one, we may earn a commission at no extra cost to you. That is the whole business model — no paid placements, no sponsored rankings. See the affiliate disclosure.
